render_schematic_with_pixel2block: render a Minecraft schematic .npy file into vision images and pixel-to-block correspondence maps using the CLI
run_render_function: run the render function to generate chunky PNG images and p2b numpy files from a schematic
read_pixel2block_binary: read a blockpos binary file and convert it to a pixel-to-block numpy array with boundary validation
compute_ground_height: compute the ground height of a Minecraft schematic by finding the Y layer with the most dirt blocks
convert_yaw_pitch_to_unit_vec: convert yaw and pitch angles in degrees to a 3D unit direction vector for camera positioning
